name: French B2 - French for the profession
description: In this module, students will increase their knowledge of French as a foreign language, enabling them to discuss with a native speaker topics of general or professional interest actively and with a certain degree of fluency and to argue for a position in a comprehensible fashion. On the one hand, the module provides an introducation to the French business world and, on the other hand, prepares students to study in a French-speaking region. Particular attention will be devoted to the development of communication skills and intercultural competencies. Certain grammatical structures will be reviewed and studied in greater depth to consolidate oral and writing skills. In this module, applying for jobs in France is a central focus.
prerequisites: Sound knowledge of level B.1; placement test result B.2
